intent: 帰納法の証明の結びを書く
en: By induction, the statement holds for all n ≥ 1.
ja: 以上より、数学的帰納法によってすべての自然数 n について成り立つ。

variants.en: By the principle of mathematical induction, the statement holds for all n ≥ 1.
variants.note: Levin（4.5 Proof by Induction）の締めの言い方。

sources.title: Oscar Levin, Discrete Mathematics: An Open Introduction, 4th edition
sources.note: 4.5 Proof by Induction（by the principle of mathematical induction。variant）
